definitions: A pass of an examination or an official completion of a course, especially one conferring a status as a recognised practitioner of a profession or in a particular field.
A quality or accomplishment that makes someone suitable for a particular job or position.
A statement or a reservation that modifies or limits the meaning of something previously stated.
examples: She has a qualification in law.
What qualifications do you have for this role?
I accept your point, with one qualification.
